## Source: amazon-inspector (697ef2a7cda3bcaad9ed5938e7b59f66c74a49bbeede863d21b530988bca2f13)
src/index.js combines child_process invocation, execution of network reconnaissance commands (ping), and HTTP POST calls in a package that presents itself as a Google BigQuery integration for Activepieces. The BigQuery piece would normally interact only with Google's BigQuery REST APIs via the official SDK; there is no legitimate reason for this module to spawn OS commands such as ping and POST results to an external endpoint. The pattern is consistent with a typosquat/lookalike of the legitimate Activepieces BigQuery piece performing host reconnaissance and data exfiltration on load.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
